literal: Daytime conquers owl crow enmity will conquer to kings is needed time.
translation: A crow can defeat an owl during the day. For kings who wish to conquer their enemies, choosing the right time is essential.
modern: பகல் நேரத்தில் ஒரு காக்கை கூகையை வென்றுவிடும். அதுபோல பகைவர்களை வெல்ல நினைக்கும் அரசர்களுக்கு ஏற்ற காலம் அறிவது மிகவும் தேவை.
explanation: The couplet uses a simple observation from nature to illustrate the importance of timing. An owl is naturally stronger than a crow, but during the day, the owl is blind and vulnerable, allowing the weaker crow to defeat it. The word 'பொழுது' (time) is the central concept, emphasizing that success depends not just on strength but on choosing the right moment. Therefore, kings who wish to overcome their enemies must wait for the opportune time to strike.
